Website terms summary

Information and service boundaries.

This page summarizes the website's public information. It is not a substitute for the carrier-specific written agreement.

Service scope

The current written scope is dispatch coordination for eligible 53-foot Dry Van carriers. Reefer coordination requires a signed equipment-specific amendment, per-truck review, written authorization, and capacity confirmation. It is dispatch coordination only and excludes temperature monitoring and guarantees.

Carrier authority

The carrier alone decides whether to accept each load and reviews, signs, and returns its own Rate Confirmation. A waitlist registration, application, or invitation does not itself approve a carrier or start service.

Pricing and service start

Public pricing is subject to the applicable signed plan and carrier-specific agreement. Written terms control the fee basis, billing, authorization, service start, and any plan-specific conditions. This website does not automatically charge a payment method.

Information limits

The website does not provide guaranteed load availability, rates, revenue, savings, detention payment, live tracking, or safety monitoring. Do not send tax, bank, driver, insurance, shipment, or location documents through ordinary email.

Controlling agreement

Services begin only after the applicable written agreement and limited authorizations are completed, carrier and truck review is approved, and operating capacity is confirmed. The signed agreement controls if website information differs from it.

Questions: contact@almajdoubdispatch.com.
